FEDERAL TERRITORY (PLANNING) ACT 1982

FEDERAL TERRITORY (PLANNING) (FEES FOR PURCHASE OF LOCAL PLAN)

RULES 2018

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 16 and paragraph 64(2)(j) of the

Federal Territory (Planning) Act 1982 [Act 267], the Commissioner of the City of

Kuala Lumpur, with the approval of the Minister, makes the following rules:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) These rules may be cited as the Federal Territory (Planning)

(Fees for Purchase of Local Plan) Rules 2018.

(2) These Rules come into operation on 12 November 2018.

Fees

2. The fees for the purchase of a copy of the local plan under section 16 of the Act,

that is Kuala Lumpur City Plan 2020 shall be as specified in the Schedule.

SCHEDULE

[Rule 2]

(1)

Copy

(2)

Fee

(RM)

(a) national language

(i) hard copy 200.00

(ii) electronic form 150.00

(b) English language

(i) hard copy 250.00

 (ii) electronic form 150.00

Made 24 October 2018

[DBKL/JUP/BPPP/GN/808 (JLD.3); PN(PU2)396/VI]

DATO' NOR HISHAM BIN AHMAD DAHLAN

Commissioner of the City of Kuala Lumpur
